_meta.description: Single source of truth for which symbols are eligible for live/paper trading. A symbol is TRADEABLE only if it has BOTH sufficient price history AND verified cost calibration data.
_meta.data_integrity_fix_20260726: The v1.0.0 'MEASURED'/'Properly measured multi-day' notes on NAS100/USOIL/USDJPY were false — see config/cost_calibration.json's data_integrity_fix_20260726 field. NAS100 is moved to excluded (zero real data, fails this file's own tradeable bar). XAUUSD/USDJPY upgraded to real tick-derived numbers (FROM_TICKS, ~27h, not multi-day). OIL restored to its real single-snapshot measurement.
